name: pr-and-issue-discipline
description: PR bodies and issues that show the change instead of describing it, shaped to the change, with the human part short and anything written for a tool collapsed at the bottom; plain-first replies to issue reporters.

interface.shortDescription: PRs and issues that show the change instead of describing it.
interface.longDescription: Fires when an agent opens a pull request, writes or changes its body or title, writes an issue, or replies to an issue reporter or outside contributor. Bodies show the change in a block (captured output where behavior is observable, a diagram or table where not) inside the shape or repository template chosen once per session at plan time, keep the human-facing part short, and collapse anything written for a bot reviewer or another agent into one Technical details section at the bottom. Replies to reporters lead with a plain-language part opening with a TL;DR list of what would help, adding a collapsed technical part only when it carries more. Every PR opens as a draft and is handed to the pr-landing-discipline skill from there.
defaultPrompt: Open a draft PR for this branch with a body that shows the change.
Write the issue for this bug so the failure is shown, not described.
Reply to this issue reporter in plain language first.
